input.title: Best way to back up notes?

steps.standardize:
kestrel 2 days ago

I keep my notes as plain markdown files. What is the least painful way to back them up off-site?

pomelo

least painful way

Use an encrypted sync. Anything else is a chore you will skip.

  • test restores
  • keep two copies

anon

+1 to the above.

Suggested

  • Sync conflicts
